text:
Leah: quick one 420pm PT  UI review: thresholds row. Should unit selection be a tiny inline dropdown next to number, or a micro toggle labelled 'short / verbose'? Also suppression preview collapses channel pills at 320px and overlaps the rule name. screenshot: https://img.redwood.test/ux/overlap-320.png

Omar: I prefer inline dropdown for clarity, but it adds visual weight. Toggle could work if we ensure full-word option is announced to ATs. Suggest `aria-pressed` + `aria-label` on the toggle states.

Priya: Copy thing: helper says "when latency > 200ms". Can we change to "when p95 latency exceeds 200 ms over 5 minutes" so it's explicit which percentile and window.

Diego: On the muted channels: current style uses 14px #666 on #fff which fails AA. a11y-bot flagged it earlier. Need either darker color or bold to meet 4.5.

a11y-bot: Contrast check: #666 on #fff = 4.0 (fails AA for 14px). Recommended: #2F2F2F or increase font-weight to 600 to reach 4.5 ratio. Also recommend visible focus on channel pills when tabbed.

Leah: Mobile pattern: stop using horizontal scroll for pills. Instead show first two pills and a "+N more" button that expands a stacked list. Screen readers fare better with that.

Omar: UX edge: previews hide fallback channels when a routing rule has a primary + fallback. We should surface fallback with a subtle divider: "Primary: Slack (latency) / Fallback: Email (on error)". Also show a tooltip explaining why fallback triggers.

Priya: Accessibility acceptances: 1) Tab order flows threshold input -> unit control -> suppression toggle -> preview expand -> save 2) When suppression toggled, an aria-live polite region announces "2 channels muted" 3) Muted pill color meets contrast and has visible focus ring.

Diego: Small copy tweak: change "Preview (3)" to "Previewing 3 channels" - full verb reduces ambiguity. For muted count, append " 1 muted" or show subdued badge.

Leah-bot: I've added comments on Figma frame: https://figma.redwood.in/frame/alerting-thresholds-v2. Action items: Omar to propose control for unit (dropdown vs toggle) with aria attributes, Priya to update helper language and confirm wording, Diego to pick accessible color tokens and update design token file, Leah to add mobile stacked preview pattern and update specs. Target: next design sync Friday.

Omar: Will mock both controls and post by Thursday EOD.

Priya: I'll draft copy in figma comments and link docs for p95/time window.

Diego: I'll run contrast tests and update tokens repo.

Leah: thanks team :raised_hands:
